cases.purpose: strace -- CMD traces the deterministic child with one line per syscall.
cases.oracle: The guest-only helper compiles an x86_64 static nostdlib tracee that checks write returns 12 and openat returns -ENOENT before exit_group(42). Direct execution checks exact stdout, stderr, and status. An independent native ptrace observer checks the exact four syscall entries, returns, and child status. Parser positive and negative controls run before the candidate; any failed setup control is an ERROR. Raw compiler, direct, native, and candidate observations are retained.
cases.comparison: The stderr trace has exactly one ordered record per known syscall and stdout matches the direct control. Every invocation independently requires the exact controlled stdout marker, exit status 42 and the ordered selected calls on the expected trace destination; with -o the route file must be nonempty and stderr empty. Common checks and the individual requirement are recorded separately. The execve parser also accepts the controlled single-element argv array and a bounded environment-count annotation.
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r guest_marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r guest_vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $guest_vendor == QEMU && $guest_marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(/usr/bin/uname -m) == x86_64 ]] || exit 125
rc=0
strace -- ./tracee-core >"$HOME/candidate.out" 2>"$HOME/candidate.err" || rc=$?
printf "%s\n" "$rc" >"$HOME/candidate.status"
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/strace-exec-output-filter-reviewed.py exec-lines
